input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "insur" and "coverage" return nothing, and the General Provisions section (10.1-10.8) contains no insurance obligation. HDI hosts the Site and, per Section 8.1, has access to Content, user information and Company data, so it is exactly the type of vendor for which the playbook expects coverage; absence of any insurance for a vendor processing personal data is walk-away territory. Inserted the preferred package (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request) as a new Section 10.9, with E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance clause in General Provisions
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance obligation even though HDI hosts the Site and handles our Content and customer data, so we have added a standard insurance provision (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation, certificates on request). We can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: 10.9 Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering HDI's processing of Content, user information and other Company data; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. HDI shall provide the Company with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
